change: Business Profile status card represents external POS/ERP integration, rather than authenticated account membership.

statuses.configured: Current live five-digit branch key with transactions:write, awaiting accepted external source event
statuses.integrated: Accepted NUERS-ingestion-1 event for same merchant/key/branch, current live key and active business
statuses.inactive: Existing live credentials inactive, expired or missing valid write/branch scope
statuses.paused: Prior accepted intake with current key, but business is not active

exclusions: BIR acceptance or live availability claims
